title: Bank-VRX
description: The ultimate banking plugin for your server. Players can found banks, manage joint accounts, issue physical cards, and compete in a dynamic free market with custom interest rates and fees.
body:
# 🏦 VRX-Bank: The Ultimate Player-Driven Economy System

Transform your Minecraft server's economy with **VRX-Bank**, a highly advanced, fully customizable, and interactive banking plugin. Move away from boring, static server shops and let your players take control of the market! 

With VRX-Bank, players can simply use the `/bank` command to access the entire system, found their own banking empires, compete for customers with custom interest rates, issue physical bank cards, and trade on a dynamic stock market.

## ✨ Core Features

### 🖥️ Centralized GUI System (`/bank`)
Everything starts with a single command! Players type `/bank` to open a stunning, fully-featured main menu where they can manage their accounts, handle their bank, or check the stock market.

### 🏢 Player-Owned Banks & Free Market
Players can invest their money to found a bank. As a bank owner, they have access to a powerful GUI dashboard to manage their empire:
* **Custom Interest Rates & Fees:** Compete with other banks by setting your own deposit interest rates and maintenance fees!
* **Staff Management:** Hire other players as employees to help run the business.
* **Infrastructure Upgrades:** Invest company capital to level up your bank, increasing the maximum amount of customers, employees, and ATMs.
* **Customer Database:** View all clients and freeze/lock accounts of suspicious players.

### 💳 Physical Bank Cards & ATMs
Say goodbye to simple chat commands. VRX-Bank introduces a physical banking experience!
* **Bank Cards:** Players can print physical Bank Cards (Custom Items) bound to their account.
* **Working ATMs:** Bank owners can purchase and place physical ATMs (Custom Heads) in the world. 
* **Secure Interactions:** To use an ATM, a player *must* hold their active bank card in their hand. Lost your card? Lock it remotely via your account dashboard!

### 💰 Advanced Financial Tools
* **Joint Accounts:** Add trusted friends to your account with specific roles (Full Access or Guest/Deposit-Only).
* **Loans:** Need money fast? Apply for a loan at a player's bank. Owners can review and approve/reject applications. Loans are automatically paid back via daily installments.
* **Fixed Deposits:** Lock your funds away for a set amount of days to earn massive interest returns.
* **Life Insurance:** Pay a daily premium to secure a massive payout to your account in case you die.

### 📈 Dynamic Stock Market (Wallstreet)
Let your players become investors! 
* Buy and sell shares of other players' banks.
* Share prices are calculated dynamically based on the bank's total company capital.
* Earn passive income through automated dividend payouts based on the bank's success.

## ⚙️ Admin & Server Features
* **Premium GUIs:** Completely chest-GUI driven with a beautiful, symmetrical, and modern glass-pane design.
* **Database Support:** Seamlessly works with SQLite (Out of the box) or MySQL (for larger networks).
* **Multi-Language:** Fully translatable. Comes with high-quality English (`en`) and German (`de`) language files by default.
* **Highly Configurable:** Almost every limit, cost, fee, and timer can be adjusted in the clean, well-documented `config.yml`.

---
*Take your server's roleplay and economy to the next level with VRX-Bank!*
